QuestInfo.name: Letting Dead Things Lie
QuestInfo.0: The Grim Reaper interrupts you on your way to investigate the time capsule's owner, and urges you to ignore the girl's request. He warned that dredging up memories of the dead after all these years may bring nothing but pain. You decided to heed his warning. Will you ever learn the girl's true identity?
